  else:
   command=training_command(s,directory,source,'offline');recovery.append({'variant':variant['name'],'restart_unfinished_without_valid_checkpoint':True,'new_directory':str(directory)})
 write(directory/'command.json',command);write(directory/'spec.json',s);write(out/'recovery_attempts.json',recovery)

"""Paired loaded transitions, general tracking, and unchanged public programs."""
import gzip,hashlib,json
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from emet.rl.regression_gate import verify_regressions
from emet.rl.manipulation.carry_benchmark import source_hashes
from emet.rl.manipulation.env import ManipulationConfig
from emet.rl.manipulation.evaluation import evaluate
from emet.rl.manipulation.grasp_lift import export_cases
from emet.rl.manipulation.hold_experiment import evidence
from emet.rl.manipulation.policy import ManipulationPolicy
from emet.eval.mars_tamp_sequences import run_sequence,manifest
from emet.eval.mars_tamp_control import CANONICAL_SUITE

torch.set_num_threads(1)
verify_regressions(Path('paper/data/whole_body_control/grasp-lift-v2-regressions.receipt.json'))
root=Path('logs/manipulation/mars-grasp-lift-v15');spec=json.loads((root/'spec.json').read_text())
assert (root/'complete.json').exists()
finals=json.loads((root/'final_checkpoints.json').read_text())
out=Path('logs/eval/grasp-lift-v15-20261027');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
cfg=ManipulationConfig(**spec['environment'])
catalog={c['id']:c for c in json.loads(CANONICAL_SUITE.read_text())['cases']}
single=json.loads(Path('configs/benchmarks/mars_agent_controller_v1.json').read_text())
multi=json.loads(Path('configs/benchmarks/mars_tamp_policy_development_v1.json').read_text())
report=dict(scope=__doc__,source_hashes=source_hashes(),tamp_sources=manifest(),variants={},
            general_teachers={},complete=False,hardware_used=False,safety_promoted=False,
            driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
def save():
    summary=dict(complete=report['complete'],safety_promoted=False,variants={},general_teachers={k:v['summary'] for k,v in report['general_teachers'].items()})
    for name,v in report['variants'].items():
        summary['variants'][name]=dict(checkpoint=v['checkpoint'],general={k:r['summary'] for k,r in v['general'].items()},
            lifts=[dict(seed=c['seed'],initialization_failed=c['initialization_failed'],code=c['final_info'].get('code'),success=c['final_info'].get('is_success',False),first_settle_s=c['final_info'].get('time_to_first_settle'),position_error_m=c['final_info'].get('ee_position_error'),orientation_error_rad=c['final_info'].get('ee_orientation_error'),wheel_lift=c['final_info'].get('wheel_lift'),retention_lost=c['final_info'].get('retention_lost')) for c in (v.get('lifts') or {}).get('cases',[])],
            programs=[{k:e.get(k) for k in ['kind','case','success','completed_stages','robot_failure','policy_calls','stop_confirmed','failure_at']} for e in v['programs']])
    (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    raw=(json.dumps(report,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode();(out/'report.json.gz').write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0))
    summary['uncompressed_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest();(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
launch=json.loads((root/'launch.json').read_text())
initial=Path(launch['source_checkpoint'])
entries=[('source',initial,initial/'checkpoint_evidence.json')]
for name in ['control','transitions']:
    final=Path(finals[name]);base=final.parent;run=json.loads((base/'run.json').read_text())
    directory=out/name;directory.mkdir()
    manifests={p.name:json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text()) for p in base.glob('step-*') if (p/'manifest.json').exists()}
    ev=evidence(directory,ManipulationConfig(**run['env']),manifests,training_run=run)
    entries.append((name,final,ev))
for name,bundle,ev in entries:
    actor=ManipulationPolicy(bundle)
    v=dict(checkpoint=str(bundle),evidence=str(ev),lifts=None,general={},programs=[])
    report['variants'][name]=v
    v['lifts']=export_cases(cfg,out/(name+'-loaded-cases'),samples=8,seed=spec['validation_seeds'][0],policy=actor)
    save();print('LOADED',name,[(r['seed'],r['final_info'].get('code')) for r in v['lifts']['cases']],flush=True)
    for i,probe in enumerate(spec['general_validation']):
        generic=replace(cfg,scenario='reach',grasp_lift_probability=0,reach_hold_probability=0,reach_local_probability=0,reach_local_translation_probability=0,hold_pregrasp_fixture=False,fixed_base_probability=0,reach_target_mode=probe['mode'],retarget_probability=probe['retarget'],reach_push_probability=probe['push'])
        seed=3120000+i*1000
        if probe['name'] not in report['general_teachers']:
            report['general_teachers'][probe['name']]=evaluate(config=generic,episodes=2,seed=seed)
        v['general'][probe['name']]=evaluate(actor,config=generic,episodes=2,seed=seed)
        save();print('GENERAL',name,probe['name'],v['general'][probe['name']]['summary']['reach']['success_rate'],flush=True)
    for case_id in single['cases']:
        r=run_sequence(catalog[case_id],single['program'],policy_directory=bundle,policy_evidence=ev,arm_execution='cartesian')
        r['kind']='single_delivery';v['programs'].append(r);save()
        print('DELIVERY',name,case_id,r['success'],r.get('robot_failure'),flush=True)
    # Preserve the original multi-transfer gate; it remains meaningful even
    # when the corresponding first delivery failed. No failed case is omitted.
    for case_id in multi['cases']:
        r=run_sequence(catalog[case_id],multi['program'],policy_directory=bundle,policy_evidence=ev,arm_execution='cartesian')
        r['kind']='original_multi_transfer';v['programs'].append(r);save()
        print('MULTI',name,case_id,r['success'],r.get('robot_failure'),flush=True)
base=report['variants']['source']
for v in report['variants'].values():
    for a,b in zip(base['lifts']['cases'],v['lifts']['cases'],strict=True):
        assert a['seed']==b['seed']
        assert a['admission']['initial_state']==b['admission']['initial_state']
    for a,b in zip(base['programs'],v['programs'],strict=True):
        assert a['case']['id']==b['case']['id'] and a['initial_state']['qpos']==b['initial_state']['qpos']
report['matched_initial_physics']=True
assert report['source_hashes']==source_hashes() and report['tamp_sources']==manifest()
report['complete']=True;save();print('GRASP_LIFT_EVALUATION_COMPLETE',flush=True)
